name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region on 21 Nov; northern China's cold wave eased by 19 Nov
state: A cold wave swept northern China from 15 to 19 Nov, with China's National Meteorological Centre issuing an orange blizzard warning for eastern Heilongjiang and Jilin and a blue cold-wave warning in Inner Mongolia; no deaths or outages were reported (The Watchers). US winter storm warnings for the Sierra Nevada expired early on 20 Nov (NWS via Defcon Level). These were not top-tier warnings, and searches on 21 Nov found no cold-related power or gas outages, so Normal is kept.
for_you: No major cold wave is affecting large populations. Winter weather can disrupt travel in northern China, the northern US and the UK at this time of year; follow the Met Office and national weather services.
rubric_hit: Normal: no top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region; China's orange blizzard warning is second-highest tier

sources.title: The Watchers — Cold wave brings 17°C temperature drops, blizzards and road closures to northern China, November 15-19
Defcon Level (NWS) — Winter Storm Warning issued November 19 until November 20 by NWS Sacramento CA

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
